summary: Production-quality code. Workflow uses pinned action refs (v4, v2), least-privilege permissions, sensible triggers (push/pr/schedule/dispatch), proper GitHub Actions output/job-dependency patterns. TypeScript: explicit types, interfaces, clear separation of concerns across semver/commits/changelog/bumper/cli. Comprehensive act-based integration testing with realistic test cases (feat→minor, breaking→major, fix→patch, no-release). Minor maintainability: version file format detection (JSON vs plain) is rigid; COPY_ITEMS list requires manual updates; hardcoded 2026-06-26 date is appropriate for reproducibility.
